messages:
oliver: heads-up — sudden jump in Pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1c since ~11:40 UTC. lots of tiny jobs (qos=tiny, 0.05-0.25 GPU) getting preempted/evicted immediately after schedule. looks like a taint landed on multiple 'lattice' nodes. cc @devin @sam :concerned:

devin: seeing it. events show automated taint `gpu-maint:NoSchedule` applied to nodes with label `lattice=true` at 11:38. That selector shouldn't have included ap-southeast1c lattice cluster. eviction rate ~9/min. pending jumped 30->180 in 10m.

sam: i pushed a lattice-label normalization last night to unify rack naming. the syncer trimmed some labels and the maintenance job's selector `lattice in (true)` accidentally matched extra nodes. my fault.

oliver: this is a fragmentation+preempt lattice problem: tiny pods are scattered, eviction requeues them and autoscaler spins warm nodes that then hit taints -> tight oscillation and cost burn.

infra-sre: quick cost note: warm churn ~= 4 GPU-hrs in last 15m. warm coldstart ~5m each. if this runs another 30m we'll hit the daily ops burn threshold. recommend rollback taint + pause autoscaler as fast mitigation.

devin: agreed. plan: 1) remove taints on affected lattice nodes, 2) pause regional autoscaler, 3) add temporary scheduler soft-preference to coalesce fractional pods (fractional-pack score tweak) to reduce spread while we fix the rollout. i'll run rollback now.

```
# remove taints
kubectl taint node node-apse1c-lat0{1,2,3,4} gpu-maint:NoSchedule- || true
# pause autoscaler for ap-southeast1
hpa pause --region ap-southeast1
```

ops-bot: Incident bot: Eviction surge (ap-southeast1 lattice) acknowledged by devin at 11:49 UTC. Autoscaler paused.

devin: untaints applied. watching eviction-controller and scheduler. pending started to drain within ~70s; eviction rate down to ~0.8/min.

sam: i'll revert the syncer change and add an explicit whitelist for lattice node IDs in the rollout. i'll also add a canary gate that checks `pending_gpu < 20` and `eviction_rate < 1/min` before tainting other lattices.

infra-sre: please add a cost-hedge alert: page when warm-pool scale >1.5x baseline for >10m. i'll draft a short runbook: rollback-taint -> pause-autoscaler -> apply-fractional-coalesce -> safe-reapply-with-canary. include estimated costs.

oliver: for medium-term, we should consider scheduler improvements: a fractional-affinity score and a tiny-pod packing policy to reduce cross-node scatter. also protect maintenance orchestration from broad regex selectors.

devin: leaving autoscaler paused for 20m and monitoring. if eviction spikes again i'll re-open.

ops-bot: Alert cleared: Eviction rate normalized. Logged incident 2026-03-23-apse1c-lattice-taint-overshoot. :white_check_mark:
